summary: Athena Technology Acquisition Corp. II, a Delaware SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a September 24, 2026 waiver to its December 4, 2024 Business Combination Agreement with Ace Green Recycling, amended March 19 and April 18, 2026. The parties waived BCA provisions requiring SPAC Warrants to be approved for Nasdaq listing, since the warrants cannot meet Nasdaq Rule 5515(a)(4)'s minimum 100 round-lot public holder requirement. No price, premium, or close date stated. Watch Nasdaq common-stock listing clearance, redemption levels, and whether the waived warrant listing signals closing risk or renegotiated deal economics.
